summary.value: Proposal to the voters at the June 7, 2016 election to amend the Charter to authorize the Board of Supervisors to update inclusionary or affordable housing obligations and to set increased interim requirements, including 25% of units as affordable for projects of 25 or more units that build the affordable units on site.
